title: Enterprise gating and prioritization matrix for security & privacy asks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Enterprise customers increasingly submit heterogeneous security and privacy requests (SOC2/ISO evidence requests, HIPAA controls, GDPR/DPA language, and vendor questionnaires). Current intake is ad hoc, routing is inconsistent, and engineering/legal handoffs are slow. Goal: Define and implement a repeatable gating and prioritization matrix for non-bug security & compliance asks that: 1) standardizes intake metadata, 2) auto-scores requests by risk/cost/SLAs, 3) defines routing rules to Security/Legal/Engineering/Dedicated Sales, and 4) provides measurable SLAs and handoff artifacts. Scope: product + PM owned intake form, scorecard rules, mapping to owners, initial automation in Zendesk/Linear, reporting dashboard and runbook. Out of scope for this ticket: full vendor questionnaire automation (separate epic), infra-level changes to KMS or customer-managed keys. Acceptance criteria: 1) Intake form published with required fields and enumerations for request type, compliance frameworks referenced, customer tier, data residency needs, regulatory deadline. 2) Prioritization matrix documented with scoring thresholds and routing rules. 3) Initial automation implemented to create Linear issues with labels and owner assignment for >=80% of test cases. 4) Runbook and SLA published (Triage within 2 business days, Response plan within 10 business days for medium risk). 5) Dashboard tracking intake volume, mean time to first response, and time to resolution for each framework. Success metrics: reduce average engineer handoff time by 40% on matched requests, cut time-to-response to enterprise compliance asks by 30% in quarter after launch. Key stakeholders: Legal (Lina Rodriguez), Security (Rafael Ortega), Solutions Eng (Priya Kulkarni), Enterprise Sales (Derek Moss).
